resources.string: Homifito DJ: the mascot behind his booth, moving with the music
Homifito DJ: he mixes with you behind his own booth
The whole DJ board in his colours: mint deck A, pink deck B, navy waveforms. Works in light and dark.

He bobs on the beat, scratches, reaches for the crossfader and cheers on the pads. Follows the Motion setting. On short screens Big shrinks to the booth, and on a phone on its side he hides to leave room for the controls.
